1. INTRODUCTION
These terms govern the rights and obligations of the seller and the buyer arising from a purchase contract concluded through the online shop.

2. CONCLUSION OF THE CONTRACT
All product presentations are informative only. The contract is concluded when the buyer sends the order and the seller accepts it.

3. PRICE AND PAYMENT
The buyer may pay by bank transfer or cash on delivery.

4. WITHDRAWAL FROM THE CONTRACT
The buyer acknowledges that goods customised to the buyer's wishes cannot be returned.

5. DEFECTIVE PERFORMANCE
Rights from defective performance are governed by the applicable legislation.

6. PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION
Personal data is processed in accordance with the GDPR.

7. FINAL PROVISIONS
The relationship is governed by Czech law. The rights of the consumer under mandatory legislation remain unaffected.
